<function name="GetHitboxSet" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns entity's current hit box set</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The current hit box set id, or no value if the entity doesn't have hit boxes</ret>
		<ret name="" type="string">The current hit box set name, or no value if the entity doesn't have hit boxes</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
